text: PM asked the UI designer to design a menu for all these functions and to design a multi-page LCD screen menu.
Decisions aim to target users under forty, balance functionality with ease, and include LCD screen and speech recognition to appeal to younger users while keeping classic functions.

Two groups of functions are defined: simple for the general public and advanced for younger users; provide a screen-based option to configure advanced features via a clear menu while keeping basic functions on the device; place the screen on top with a visual separation between the two groups.

Data is organized into three categories and grouped into two groups: display and basic functions; address problems such as dislike of look-and-feel, mismatch with operating behaviour, and remotes being easily lost.
